merit.title: Benefits of Foreign Recruitment
merit.item1_description: In Japan, where the population is aging and declining, it is difficult to secure young, excellent talent. Expanding the applicant pool increases the chances of meeting excellent talent. ITF Co., Ltd. supports foreign recruitment services for caregiving, hotels, and restaurants across Japan.
merit.item2_description: Attract foreign customers through multilingual customer service and communication in their native languages. ITF Co., Ltd. provides foreign recruitment support nationwide in Japan.
merit.item3_description: Foreigners have the ability to adapt to various situations while living and working in a foreign country. Due to differences in education and culture compared to Japanese people, they can identify issues unnoticed by Japanese and bring new ideas and perspectives. We specialize in foreign talent introduction services for caregiving.
merit.item4_description: Foreign talent brings diverse cultural backgrounds and perspectives, providing new ideas to the company. This promotes innovation and improvement in operations. We also support caregiving services in Japan.
merit.item5_description: Hiring foreign talent with advanced expertise and skills in specific fields strengthens your company's competitiveness and ensures an edge in the industry. We specialize in foreign recruitment for caregiving and nursing fields.
merit.item6_description: Foreign staff have extensive networks, including their home countries, which can be leveraged to expand international business opportunities. ITF Co., Ltd. introduces foreign caregiving talent nationwide in Japan.

about.title: About Us
about.heading: What is ITF (アイティーエフ)?
about.description: 'Illuminate The Future' ITF is a company that supports foreigners working in Japan through foreign talent recruitment assistance. We serve as a bridge between companies and foreign job seekers, providing accurate and reliable matching that meets the needs of both parties. With the desire to 'help as many foreigners and companies as possible,' ITF aims to be the leading company in nationwide foreign talent introduction services.

service.main_title: ITF's Foreign Talent<br class="sp">Introduction Plan Details
service.description: ITF (ITF Co., Ltd.) provides a one-stop solution for corporate recruitment challenges, from introducing specified skilled workers and technical interns to providing registration support, nationwide. We specialize in foreign recruitment services for caregiving, hotels, and restaurants.
service.item1_subtitle: We have many foreigners registered both domestically and internationally.
service.item1_description: We have a wide range of talent from various nationalities, including Vietnamese, Indonesians, and Chinese, as well as specified skilled workers (level 1). We can introduce talent tailored to your needs. Through partnerships with multiple sending organizations, overseas talent, universities, vocational schools, and Japanese language schools (approximately 10 schools), we can introduce caregiving talent that matches your requirements nationwide in Japan. We introduce candidates who have passed the skills tests, Japanese language tests, and caregiving Japanese tests required for Specified Skilled Worker (level 1). We also introduce excellent talent under specific activities.
service.item2_description: Introduced in April 2019, 'Specified Skilled Worker' is a new residency status that allows the hiring of foreign talent in 12 industries, including food service, caregiving, and lodging. Since they have passed Japanese language and industry-specific skills tests before coming to Japan, they are expected to be an immediate asset in the workplace right after joining. We also support caregiving talent recruitment in Japan.
service.item3_subtitle: We provide thorough support for hired talent.
service.item3_description: Our staff from the same nationality as the talent provide dedicated support for administrative procedures, daily life necessities, and more, to improve retention rates. As a registered support organization, we also assist companies with onboarding support. We have received requests from various companies. We can support foreign caregiving talent nationwide in Japan.
service.item4_description: Our company has a diverse staff, including Vietnamese, Indonesians, Chinese, Nepalese, and more. This allows us to provide support in the job seekers' native languages, ensuring they can use our services with confidence in various situations such as hearings and consultations. Our staff, who understand the culture and background of each country, provide smooth and heartfelt support. We also support caregiving services in Japan.

solution.point1_title: Introducing Diverse Talent from Partner Institutions in Six Asian Countries
solution.point1_description: ITF collaborates with local partner institutions in six countries, primarily in Southeast Asia, to recruit and train young people eager to work in Japan. We can quickly introduce talent with diverse skills to meet your company's needs. We also support foreign recruitment services for caregiving, hotels, and restaurants in Japan.
solution.point2_title: Selection and Recommendation by Native Language Staff to Match Needs and Achieve High Retention Rates
solution.point2_description: Our native language staff carefully explain the company's philosophy, vision, and management policies to local candidates, ensuring their understanding. This prevents mismatches after joining and enables smoother onboarding. We support foreign caregiving talent nationwide in Japan.
solution.point3_title: Providing Employment Opportunities Across a Wide Range of Industries
solution.point3_description: ITF enables recruitment across 14 industries, including caregiving, food manufacturing, food service, lodging, building cleaning, material industries, industrial machinery manufacturing, electrical/electronic information industries, construction, shipbuilding/marine industry, automotive maintenance, aviation, agriculture, and fisheries. You can easily search for the best results tailored to your needs. We specialize in caregiving services in Japan.

flow.title: Process from Request to Introduction
flow.step1: Our staff will visit you to discuss job details, desired talent profiles, skills, hiring timeline, etc.
flow.step2: We will sign a basic contract for talent introduction.
flow.step3: We will carefully select candidates who match your company's needs from those we have interviewed.
flow.step4: We will continuously recommend candidates that match your company's needs.
flow.step5: You will conduct document screening based on the candidate data we recommend. Please inform us of the selection results (pass or fail).
flow.step6: We will apply for various work visas.
flow.step7: After completing the onboarding process, the fees will be finalized.
